response.message: Dobrynya must lead an army to take it on that quest
Dobrynya's army must stand in the field to set out

notifications.title: Dobrynya failed: Storm the haunted barrow
notifications.body: The army did not get there in time, and the chance is gone.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (-5, -2)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 2100 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: The forbidding ruin at (-5, 0) sank back into the earth
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (3, -4)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 1750 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: You searched the forbidding ruin at (-7, 1)
notifications.body: Bounty for Mirogost: 400 wood, 400 stone, 400 grain and 200 iron.

notifications.title: Dobrynya has done: Storm the haunted barrow
notifications.body: The army quest is done: 110 XP for Dobrynya.

notifications.title: Achievement: Grave Goods
notifications.body: Search an ancient site.

notifications.title: The Kurgan at (-7, 1) gave up 4590 resources
notifications.body: Explored and done.

notifications.title: Dobrynya reached level 4
notifications.body: A new skill point to spend.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (-5, 0)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 1400 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the north.

notifications.title: Achievement: Warleader
notifications.body: Finish a quest your hero leads the army on.

notifications.title: Dobrynya has done: Break the raiders' warband
notifications.body: The army quest is done: 70 XP for Dobrynya.

notifications.title: Achievement: Clearing the Woods
notifications.body: Clear a bandit camp.

notifications.title: Your army cleared the bandit camp at (-5, 3)
notifications.body: It carries home 4059 resources.

notifications.title: Done: Clear your first camp
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: Barracks level 1 in Mirogost
notifications.body: Finished.

notifications.title: Done: Raise a building
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: Achievement: Errand Rider
notifications.body: Bring your hero home from a quest.

notifications.title: Dobrynya is back from: Hunt the great boar
notifications.body: Brought back 0 wood, 0 stone, 700 grain and 0 iron.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (-1, -4).
